note: Draft register for Spec 072 (the Spec 048 question re-designed in ICIT numbering on the Shakti corpus), opened 2026-10-22 under the owner's readiness decisions of 2026-10-22 (research_notes/shakti-readiness-proposals-2026-10-22.md, decision 4). Conventions as in Specs 042-054: requirement claims carry no falsification test where a gate or inspection is the operative check; boundaries carry the conditions under which each claim holds; evidence items carry observed_at from this draft because the cited facts were verified first-hand at drafting. The AEE lifecycle hooks have NOT run on this register; they are the freeze gate (tasks L4, per DD-038-10), and any recovery round they force changes claim text before any freeze digest is computed. ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on: ASM-ASSET-F (Asset F as frozen at Spec 044's step 0 under its section 4 contract is the family for this test), ASM-CLOSED-RECORD (Spec 048's frozen contract, gate 0.3, and closure stand exactly as recorded and are not amended by this spec), ASM-SHAKTI-INTAKE (the Shakti corpus is citable only through the adopted intake record, P-F1 gates S1-S4, with the corpus and row-grades pins of spec section 2), ASM-T24-ANALOGUE (the T2.4-analogue measure of spec section 5.2, with its carried Phase-43 battery method labelled carried from the Item 2 record, is the measure of record), ASM-VERDICT-LINE (the verdict line L is derived at the freeze from the freeze-stage reference distribution by the rule of spec section 5.3, from non-members only, before any member is scored), ASM-CONCORDANCE (a member's Wells/ICIT identity exists for this test only as stated and pinned at gate 0.3 on the freeze-confirmed basis), ASM-GRADE-DISCIPLINE (P-F1 S4: documented-lineage primary, documented + corroborated sensitivity, undocumented-uncorroborated excluded, both populations reported), ASM-GATES-BEFORE-OUTCOME (pins, concordance, census, and verdict-line assertion precede any outcome quantity), ASM-ROIF-GATE (the Roif publication gate of claim F072-C14 holds this spec's results internal until both of its conditions are met for a specific act), ASM-APPEND-ONLY (outcomes append; frozen records are never edited). No numeric verdict line appears in this register: the line is a freeze product under F072-C09, and the register states the rule, the exclusions, and the freeze-failure case instead. The intake record cited by F072-C07 and F072-C13 is in parallel creation and is not on main at this draft; that state is recorded in the evidence item itself and in spec section 2, and the freeze re-asserts every pin against the merged record (OPEN-072-9).
